title: Dilaton-Axion Wormhole Partition Function Away from the BPS Endpoint
summary: I determine the leading finite-radius correction to the two-boundary response of a charged axion wormhole near its BPS endpoint. With $δ=a_*^2$, exact radial matching in a product axion--dilaton/saxion system gives a boundary eigenvalue that vanishes as $O(δ)$ and an off-diagonal Hessian entry of order $O(δ^2)$. Their combination produces a cross-boundary covariance linear in $δ$, with a negative first sub-leading correction on the branch studied here.
